claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_spell_grant
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Evocation Savant is not an activation: it has no activationCost, no use_count resource, and no reset cadence. It is a passive benefit that fires at acquisition and at each new spell-slot-level milestone. No existing ClassFeatureMechanics family (currently only 'activation') can encode a passive, level-progression-triggered grant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose two Wizard spells from the Evocation school, each of which must be no higher than level 2, and add them to your spellbook for free. In addition, whenever you gain access to a new level of spell slots in this class, you can add one Wizard spell from the Evocation school to your spellbook for free.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access (ClassFeatureEffect variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The effect of this feature is adding spells to the wizard's spellbook. The v4 atom 'grant_spell_access' exists in the taxonomy but there is no corresponding ClassFeatureEffect variant in types.ts. ClassFeatureEffect only contains GrantExtraActionEffect and HealHpEffect.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: add them to your spellbook for free

claude_proposed_widenings.name: on_new_spell_slot_level trigger/window
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ongoing grant fires 'whenever you gain access to a new level of spell slots in this class' — a character-progression event. This is distinct from rest_window, turn_start_window, and all other v4 window atoms, which are combat or rest cadence events. A new window kind is needed for level-up progression triggers.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: whenever you gain access to a new level of spell slots in this class, you can add one Wizard spell from the Evocation school to your spellbook for free
